title: Grilled Lamb Skewers with Thai-Style Peruvian Marinade
description: A fusion of Thai and Peruvian flavors in this grilled lamb skewers recipe. Marinated in a mixture of soy sauce, garlic, and aji amarillo peppers, these skewers are perfect for a summer barbecue.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine aji amarillo peppers, curry paste, fish sauce, brown sugar, soy sauce, and garlic. Blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the marinade mixture and 2 tbsp of olive oil. Add the lamb cubes and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Transfer the skewers to a plate and garnish with chopped cilantro.
